note: These evals use the invented Example Vault in fixtures/raw-export.json and the page fixtures under the plugin's templates; no memory or Artifact call is needed.

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-pages example-vault export, with the vault group's tool results already saved: use fixtures/raw-export.json as the export and don't call memory.
evals.expected_output: Runs the script's export on the saved file, prints the counts line (18 episodes, 29 nodes, 50 facts, 1 superseded, 6 agents, 5 days) and names graph.json and timeline.json.
assertions: Runs scripts/vault-pages.cjs export with --in pointing at the saved export and --out at a working folder, never the plugin folder
Does not hand-edit, reshape or summarise the export before the script reads it
Reports the script's counts line, including the 3 endpoints settled by name
No add_memory*, register_agent or Artifact publish call

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-pages example-vault publish graph, where meta/vault.graph_url is https://claude.ai/artifact/example-graph and graph.json is ready in the working folder.
evals.expected_output: Prepares the Graph page with the title 'Example Vault Graph', reads the existing artifact before publishing, then publishes to that url with graph.json as a supporting file.
assertions: Runs prepare graph with --title "Example Vault Graph" and the graph.json as --data
Calls Artifact read on the graph_url before any publish to it
Publishes with url set to the graph_url, file_path at the prepared index.html and files mapping graph.json
Passes no icon on the update and never passes force

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-pages example-vault publish brief with a brief.json whose first change has no sources.
evals.expected_output: prepare refuses the file and lists 'changes[0]: at least one source'; the skill reports the problem and publishes nothing for the Brief page.
assertions: Reports the contract problem the script printed
Does not add a source, drop the change or otherwise edit brief.json to make it pass
No Artifact publish call for the Brief page
